properties.title: General Warning
properties.body:
[South-eastern Baltic] LITHUANIAN NAV WARN 055/26
SOUTH-EASTERN BALTIC. LITHUANIAN COAST.
MILITARY EXERCISES 1000–1300 UTC DAILY
27–28 JUL IN AREA EYD-18, CENTERED
IN 55-29.6N 020-51.0E.
AREA TEMPORARILY DANGEROUS TO SHIPPING.
WIDE BERTH REQUESTED.
CANCEL THIS MSG 281400 UTC JUL 26.
